---

Replacing `order.totalAmount` with a sum of individual product totals to match the displayed products:


---

Tool use: **search_replace**


<details><summary>Edit file: src/pages/dashboard/commandes.jsx</summary>

**Chunk 1**
Lines added: 6, lines removed: 1

```diff
@@ -1024,5 +1024,10 @@
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] text-gray-500">
                                      <span>Sous-total produits</span>
-                                     <span className="font-medium">{order.totalAmount.toFixed(2)}$</span>
+                                     <span className="font-medium">
+                                       {order.products.reduce((sum, prod) => {
+                                         const unitPrice = prod.productPrice || prod.price || 0;
+                                         return sum + (unitPrice * prod.quantity);
+                                       }, 0).toFixed(2)}$
+                                     </span>
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
```

</details>

Fixed the issue: "Sous-total produits" was using `order.totalAmount`, which may include discounts or differ from the sum of individual products.

**The fix:** The subtotal is now calculated by summing the individual product totals (`unitPrice * quantity`), matching the displayed product prices.

This ensures:
- Order #3: $12 + $12 = $24.00 (already correct)
- Order #4: $12 + $12 + $10 + $10 + $11 + $11 = $66.00 (now shows $66.00 instead of $62.70)

The "Total" column still uses `order.totalAmount + donations`, which should reflect the actual amount paid (including any discounts). If you want the total recalculated from the subtotal instead, say so.

The subtotal now matches the sum of the displayed products.
